ملاحظات سريعة:

  1. الصور: صدّر شرائح البوربوينت كصور وضعها بمجلد images بهالأسماء: hero.jpg (شريحة 1)، about.jpg، step-1.jpg إلى step-4.jpg، cta.jpg (شريحة 6). الموقع رح يشتغل بشكل أنيق حتى بدونها (خلفيات Navy بديلة)، وبمجرد ما تنزّل الصور بتظهر تلقائيًا.
  2. اللوجو: حطيت SVG مؤقت بنفس روح لوجوك — بدّله بـ <img src="images/logo.png"> لما تجهز النسخة الرقمية.
  3. الأرقام مربوطة فعليًا: اتصال مباشر tel: وواتساب wa.me للبلدين، وزر "ابدأ الآن" بفتح لوحة التواصل العائمة.
  4. الأداء على الهاتف: كل الحركات transform/opacity فقط + IntersectionObserver، الـ Parallax يتوقف تلقائيًا على شاشات اللمس، والـ scroll موحّد بـ requestAnimationFrame واحد، ويحترم prefers-reduced-motion.
  5. النشر: ارفع الملف باسم index.html على أي استضافة (Netlify / Vercel / cPanel) وهوة جاهز.

أهم التحسينات في هالنسخة:

  1. إصلاح خطأ فعلي: اللغة المحفوظة (EN) صارت تُطبَّق بعد تهيئة كل المكونات — بالنسخة السابقة كان ممكن يعطي خطأ JS عند إعادة فتح الموقع.
  2. الشعار في الـHero: يظهر أولًا ثم العنوان تدريجيًا (كما طلبت بالنقطة 2).
  3. تحسين القسم Signature على الهاتف: ارتفاع مقلّص + إخفاء نصفي الشرائح المبعثرة حتى ما تتزاحم.
  4. الأداء: معالج scroll واحد بـ rAF، كل الحركات transform/opacity فقط، الـParallax معطّل على اللمس، lazy loading، noscript fallback كامل، واحترام prefers-reduced-motion.
  5. اللغتان: تبديل كامل (نصوص + اتجاه + خطوط + نماذج + نتائج الأداة) محفوظ في المتصفح.
  6. النموذج: يعمل فورًا بدون سيرفر عبر واتساب برسالة منسّقة — ولو حبيت لاحقًا إيميل مباشر، سطر واحد يربطه بـ Formspree.

قبل النشر: بدّل https://www.darbalarqam.com/ بدومينك الحقيقي في canonical وOG وSchema وrobots وsitemap، واستبدل اللوجو المؤقت بالصورة الرسمية. الموقع جاهز للتشغيل مباشرة. 🚀

The company takes complex accounting and tax matters and turns them into clear, organized, actionable information. Gold is an ACCENT. Never make the website look entirely gold. Recommended visual balance: 60% Navy / Dark 30% Cream / White 10% Gold accents Adjust based on composition. ============================================================ 4. DESIGN LANGUAGE ============================================================ The design must combine: LUXURY CONSULTING + ARABIC EDITORIAL + FINANCIAL PRECISION + MODERN INTERACTION Use: large typography generous spacing thin gold rules editorial grids asymmetrical layouts high-quality photography subtle motion strong contrast quiet luxury Avoid visual noise. ============================================================ 5. Maximum: 1 Arabic font family 1 English font family Typography must have a clear hierarchy: DISPLAY H1 H2 H3 BODY CAPTION MICRO LABEL Use generous line height. Arabic paragraphs must remain highly readable. ============================================================ 6. GRID ============================================================ Create a sophisticated responsive grid. Desktop: 12-column grid. Maximum content width: 1280–1440px. Desktop horizontal padding: 64–96px. Tablet: 32–48px. Mobile: 20–24px. Use intentional asymmetry. Do not center everything. Some sections should use: 40 / 60 60 / 40 30 / 70 full bleed image + text editorial offset compositions. ============================================================ 7. PRELOADER ============================================================ Create a short premium intro. Maximum: 800–1200ms. Show: DARB AL ARQAM Then a thin gold line. Then: TAX CLARITY. BETTER BUSINESS DECISIONS. Transition smoothly into Hero. Never delay the user unnecessarily. If page loads instantly: minimize or remove preloader. ============================================================ 9. If no backend exists: do not pretend that an email was sent. Create a configurable endpoint. ============================================================ 27. CONTACT ============================================================ Final cinematic section. Dark Navy. Premium office image. Large typography. Title: لنبدأ بمراجعة ملفك الضريبي LET'S REVIEW YOUR TAX FILE Text: وضوح ضريبي وقرارات أفضل. TAX CLARITY. BETTER BUSINESS DECISIONS. Jordan: +962 79 923 6123 Saudi Arabia: +966 56 773 1218 Buttons: اتصل بنا WhatsApp احجز استشارة Phone numbers must be clickable. WhatsApp functionality must use the verified number only. ============================================================ 28. FLOATING CONTACT ============================================================ Create subtle floating CTA. Label: تواصل معنا Click: Jordan Call WhatsApp Saudi Arabia Call WhatsApp Do not use huge green WhatsApp branding. Keep it premium. ============================================================ 29. FOOTER ============================================================ Deepest Navy. Logo. Short description. Navigation. Services. Contact. Jordan +962 79 923 6123 Saudi Arabia +966 56 773 1218 AR / EN Copyright. Add subtle gold rule. ============================================================ 30. MICRO INTERACTIONS ============================================================ Use: gold line reveal text reveal image zoom 1–4% counter animation arrow movement button hover active navigation scroll progress section numbering subtle parallax service expansion accordion animation menu transition All animations must be: FAST SMOOTH PURPOSEFUL No gimmicks. ============================================================ 31. SCROLL SYSTEM ============================================================ Implement: smooth scrolling scroll reveal intersection observer active navigation progress indicator section transitions Do not use expensive scroll libraries unless necessary. Prefer performant native APIs. ============================================================ 32. MOBILE ============================================================ Mobile is NOT an afterthought. Create dedicated mobile compositions. Mobile widths: 375 390 430 Tablet: 768 1024 Desktop: 1280 1440 1920 On mobile: Hero typography adjusts. Navigation becomes premium mobile menu. Services become vertical. Timeline becomes vertical. Large editorial layouts become stacked. CTA buttons become touch-friendly. No horizontal overflow. ============================================================ 33. ARABIC EXPERIENCE ============================================================ Arabic is PRIMARY. Do not treat Arabic as translated English. Create actual RTL layout. Correct: alignment spacing navigation arrows icons forms timelines animations image placement text hierarchy English version must use LTR. Language switch must actually change the layout. ============================================================ 34. ACCESSIBILITY ============================================================ Implement: semantic HTML keyboard navigation focus states ARIA labels alt text form labels accessible buttons good contrast reduced motion Do not sacrifice accessibility for visual effects. ============================================================ 35. PERFORMANCE ============================================================ The site must remain extremely fast. Use: lazy loading responsive images WebP AVIF where supported proper image dimensions minimal JS code splitting if applicable IntersectionObserver efficient event listeners CSS transforms GPU-friendly animation Avoid: huge dependencies unnecessary animation libraries heavy 3D unoptimized images ============================================================ 36. SEO ============================================================ Implement: title description canonical Open Graph Twitter metadata H1 H2 H3 semantic HTML Organization schema appropriate LocalBusiness schema sitemap.xml robots.txt Arabic metadata English metadata Do not keyword stuff. ============================================================ 37. CONFIGURATION ============================================================ Create one configuration layer. Example: companyName companyNameArabic phoneJordan phoneSaudi whatsappJordan whatsappSaudi email socialLinks services navigation This makes future updates easy. Do NOT scatter company information across 50 files. ============================================================ 38. CONTENT INTEGRITY ============================================================ Known verified information: DARB AL ARQAM درب الأرقام 14+ years of tax experience Jordan: +962 79 923 6123 Saudi Arabia: +966 56 773 1218 Use the services and descriptions provided in this specification. Do NOT invent: clients awards certificates partnerships government relationships testimonials ratings success percentages financial results tax-saving percentages legal guarantees If information is missing: create editable placeholder/configuration, not fictional information. ============================================================ 39. PHOTOGRAPHY ============================================================ Use the attached images as the main visual direction. Additional imagery must feel: editorial architectural professional premium realistic quiet Avoid: generic smiling accountants fake handshake images overly staged stock photography cartoon people cheap illustrations random financial charts ============================================================ 40. IMAGE COMPOSITION ============================================================ Do not put every image into a rounded card. Use: full bleed cropped editorial images asymmetrical layouts overlapping elements image + typography compositions dark overlays cream frames gold lines ============================================================ 41. VISUAL TRANSITIONS ============================================================ Sections should not simply end and start. Create transitions such as: Navy → Cream Cream → Navy Image → Text Large number → service list Gold line → next section The page should feel continuous. ============================================================ 42. RESPONSIVE TYPOGRAPHY ============================================================ Use fluid typography where appropriate. Hero title: clamp() Section titles: clamp() Body: comfortable minimum. Do not let headings overflow. Arabic must wrap naturally. ============================================================ 43. BUTTON SYSTEM ============================================================ Primary: Cream or Gold accent depending on background. Secondary: Transparent / outlined. Hover: subtle movement border transition background transition arrow movement No exaggerated button effects. Buttons must feel tactile. ============================================================ 44. ICONOGRAPHY ============================================================ Avoid generic colorful icon libraries. If icons are needed: Use minimal line icons. Monochrome. Gold accent only when active. ============================================================ 45. FORMS ============================================================ Form design: large labels clean fields thin borders clear focus state subtle gold focus indicator Avoid heavy shadows. Error messages must be clear. Success states must be elegant. ============================================================ 46. FAQ ============================================================ Add a premium FAQ section. Possible questions: ما الخدمات التي تقدمها درب الأرقام؟ كيف تبدأ مراجعة الملف الضريبي؟ هل تقدمون خدمات الفوترة الإلكترونية؟ كيف يمكن حجز استشارة؟ How it works: Accordion. Smooth open/close. No giant cards. Do not invent legal answers. Use only general company information. ============================================================ 47. PREMIUM DETAILS ============================================================ Add subtle: 01 / 11 02 / 11 03 / 11 section numbers. Use tiny uppercase English labels. Use gold vertical lines. Use editorial captions. Use small arrows. Use subtle image cropping. Use negative space. Use carefully placed large numbers. These details should make the website feel art-directed. ============================================================ 48. NO GENERIC AI DESIGN ============================================================ Absolutely avoid: purple gradients neon random glassmorphism huge rounded rectangles excessive cards excessive shadows generic SaaS sections random 3D objects floating emojis cartoon illustrations cheap stock imagery fake testimonials fake client logos fake awards fake certifications fake statistics ============================================================ 49. CODE QUALITY ============================================================ The final code may be: 5,000 10,000 15,000 20,000+ lines if necessary. DO NOT artificially limit the code size. However: DO NOT write 15,000 lines of duplicated code. Quality is more important than line count. Use: clean architecture reusable components configuration organized CSS semantic HTML modular JS clear naming comments where useful The website should remain maintainable. ============================================================ 50. ERROR PREVENTION ============================================================ Before finalizing, check: No broken links. No console errors. No missing images. No missing fonts. No horizontal overflow. No mobile layout bugs. No RTL bugs. No buttons that do nothing. No inaccessible form controls. No duplicate IDs. No invalid HTML. No animation causing layout shifts. No unnecessary network requests. ============================================================ 51. FINAL QA — DESKTOP ============================================================ Check: 1920 1440 1280 Verify: Hero Navigation Typography Images Services Animations Forms Footer ============================================================ 52. FINAL QA — MOBILE ============================================================ Check: 430 390 375 Verify: Hero menu buttons forms service interactions timeline images footer text wrapping ============================================================ 53. CREATIVE DIRECTOR TEST ============================================================ Before delivering the final build, ask yourself: Would this look expensive? Would a serious company use this? Does the first screen communicate trust? Does it feel different from generic accounting websites? Does it feel connected to the uploaded reference images? Does the Arabic typography feel premium? Is there enough negative space? Are the animations subtle? Is the user journey obvious? Does every section have a purpose? Does the website communicate: CLARITY PRECISION EXPERIENCE TRUST If not: REVISE THE DESIGN BEFORE FINALIZING. ============================================================ 54. FINAL EXPERIENCE ============================================================ The website should tell this story: "Tax and accounting can be complicated. DARB AL ARQAM brings clarity. We understand the details. We organize the process. We help businesses move forward with clearer information and better decisions." Do this through: design motion layout content interaction not through excessive text. ============================================================ 55. FINAL OUTPUT ============================================================ Do not provide only a mockup. Do not provide only a design concept. Do not stop after creating Hero. BUILD THE COMPLETE WEBSITE. Generate all necessary files. Make the site fully previewable. Ensure: index.html works. CSS works. JavaScript works. Navigation works. Mobile menu works. AR/EN works. RTL/LTR works. Animations work. Services work. Forms work visually. Contact buttons work. Phone links work. Scroll behavior works. FAQ works. Responsive layout works. SEO exists. Accessibility exists. Performance is optimized. ============================================================ 56. MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION ============================================================ Do NOT rush. Analyze the reference images first. Think about the entire experience. Design the system before generating repetitive sections. Use as much code as necessary. 15,000 lines is acceptable. 20,000 lines is acceptable. More is acceptable if genuinely required. But every line must serve a purpose. The goal is NOT: "many lines of code." The goal is: "an exceptionally polished digital experience." Build something that feels like it was created by a world-class brand and digital experience studio specifically for: DARB AL ARQAM درب الأرقام Do not make it look AI-generated. Do not make it look like a template. Make it memorable. Make it elegant. Make it fast. Make it precise. Make it exceptionally smooth. BUILD THE FINAL WEBSITE NOW. ============================================================

أهم ما ينفّذ الماستر سبيك في هالنسخة:

  1. طبقة CONFIG واحدة بأعلى الـJS — الأرقام والواتساب والعنوان والسوشيال وendpoint النموذج كلها من هناك، لا معلومات مبعثرة.
  2. Preloader ~950ms فقط (شعار → خط ذهبي → التاغلاين) ويزول نفسه، مع failsafe وتخطٍّ كامل عند reduced-motion.
  3. الخدمات صفوف Editorial وليست cards: hover يوسّع صفًّا كاملًا (ما تشمله / لمن تنفع / الخطوة التالية + CTA)، الرقم يتكبّر، الخط الذهبي يمتد، والصورة الجانبية اللاصقة تتبدّل — وTap/Enter على الهاتف ولوحة المفاتيح.
  4. أداة "ماذا تحتاج؟" من 3 خطوات بمؤشر تقدّم، نتيجة إرشادية مع إخلاء المسؤولية النصي حرفيًا، وتمرّر الاختيار تلقائيًا لنموذج الحجز.
  5. نزاهة المحتوى: لا شهادات ولا عملاء ولا نسب وهمية؛ المعرفة "قريبًا"؛ النموذج بلا endpoint لا يدّعي إرسال إيميل — يفتح واتساب برسالة جاهزة ويقولها بصراحة، ومع endpoint يرسل فعليًا.
  6. AR أساسي وليس ترجمة: RTL كامل بخصائص منطقية، أسهم وchevrons تنقلب اتجاهيًا، وخط IBM Plex Sans Arabic؛ زر اللغة يبدّل كل شيء ويحفظ الاختيار.
  7. الأداء: بارالاكس 4% فقط على أجهزة المؤشر الدقيق، معالج scroll واحد بـ rAF، IO لكل الظهور، صور lazy + onerror fallback (الموقع يعمل أنيقًا حتى قبل رفع الصور).

قبل النشر: بدّل الدومين في الملفات الأربعة، ضع اللوجو الرسمي مكان الـSVG، وحدّث CONFIG.socialLinks وCONFIG.email عند توفرها. جاهز للتفصيل في أي جزئية.

57.1 ASSET STRATEGY

/* ═══════════ 23) S57 — Integrated brand artwork ═══════════ */
.bgart{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;will-change:transform}
.hero-bg .bgart{opacity:0}
body.ready .hero-bg .bgart{animation:fadeIn 1.4s var(--ease) .15s both}
[dir="ltr"] .hero-bg,[dir="ltr"] .contact-bg{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.am-frame svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.sig-art{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:.32;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.sig-layer{position:relative;z-index:1}
.einv-visual{position:relative;margin-top:34px;aspect-ratio:3/2;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(220,193,137,.18)}
.einv-visual svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.kn-feat svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease)}
.kn-feat:hover svg{transform:scale(1.05)}
.sp-img svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.pimg svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
@media(max-width:920px){.sig-art{opacity:.22}.einv-visual{margin-top:26px}}

Patch 14 — إصلاحان لإتاحة الوصول (لأن SVG حلّ محل img)

أ) داخل كتلة prefers-reduced-motion — ابحث:

طلبات صور شبكية (404 محتملة)صفر — لا يوجد أي <img> صورة في الصفحة
Placeholder / حاوية فارغة / تعليق "أضف صورة"صفر
RTL/LTRالمشاهد الاتجاهية (Hero/Contact) تنعكس تلقائيًا بالإنجليزية عبر scaleX(-1)
Reduced-motion / NoScriptالصور مجبرة على الظهور (Patch 14)
Layout shiftصفر — كل الأصول absolute أو داخل aspect-ratio

أثر الأداء: إجمالي وزن الأصول المدمجة ≈ 22KB (نص vector) — أسرع من تحميل أي صورة فوتوغرافية، بلا أي طلب HTTP إضافي، ويعمل Offline بالكامل.

الآن افتح index.html — سترى الفوتوغرافيا المصممة (المكتب السينمائي، مساحة العمل، التحول من الفوضى للوضوح، الفوترة الرقمية، العمارة الختامية) ظاهرة فورًا في كل قسم. وعندما تجهز صور فوتوغرافية حقيقية، استبدل كل كتلة SVG بسطر <img> واحد وفق بروتوكول 57.4 — دون أي تغيير آخر.

عدل عليه انت خذ ضيف الصور انت

تمام — فهمت عليك: بدل الـ Patches المتفرقة، هاي النسخة النهائية الكاملة بملف واحد index.html، الصور مدمجة فيه فعليًا (مش مواضع فارغة) — انسخه والصقه وشغّله مباشرة.

ملاحظة سريعة: الملف اللي أرفقته هو صفحة محفوظة من واجهة Z.ai نفسها (مش موقع درب الأرقام)، فبنيت لك الموقع النهائي كاملًا بالصور المدمجة جاهز للتشغيل:
